name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures a security-hardened multi-site Nginx stack for three hostnames, including static document roots, HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects, virtual hosts, security headers, gzip, request limits, Fail2ban, firewall and SSH hardening, and self-signed TLS certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, enables their services, creates the Redis runtime log directory, and applies the required Redis configuration workaround.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application, creates its virtual environment and dependencies, provisions the PostgreSQL database and user, and runs the application as a systemd service on port 8000.
